title: Reachability-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Impulse Interplanetary Transfers
abstract: arXiv:2610.01344v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning offers the prospect of a reusable sequential decision-making mechanism for spacecraft trajectory design, motivating policy interfaces that connect learned decisions to the underlying maneuver geometry. This paper develops Reachability Analysis-Informed Reinforcement Learning (RARL) for deterministic multi-impulse interplanetary transfers, placing intermediate waypoint selection at the center of the learned decision process. Local first-order reachability maps bounded velocity perturbations into an ellipsoidal set of next-node positions, within which the policy selects its waypoint. Lambert reconstruction then determines the corresponding maneuver to reach this selected waypoint along a dynamically consistent ballistic arc, coupling learned transfer-geometry selection with classical astrodynamics. A terminal two-impulse reconstruction completes the rendezvous, supported by a linear maneuver-demand assessment used

translated_title: 面向多脉冲行星际转移的可达性引导强化学习
translated_abstract: 强化学习为航天器轨迹设计提供了一种可复用序贯决策机制的前景，这促使人们构建将学习到的决策与底层机动几何相连接的策略接口。本文针对确定性多脉冲行星际转移提出了可达性分析引导的强化学习方法，将中间路径点的选择置于学习决策过程的核心。局部一阶可达性分析将有界的速度扰动映射为下一节点位置的椭球集合，策略在该椭球集合内选择其路径点。随后，兰伯特重构确定到达该选定路径点所需的相应机动，使航天器沿动力学一致的弹道弧段飞行，从而将学习到的转移几何选择与经典天体动力学相结合。最终由终端两次脉冲重构完成交会，并辅以线性机动需求评估提供支持。
tldr: 本文提出可达性分析引导的强化学习方法（RARL），利用局部一阶可达性椭球约束中间路径点的选择，并结合兰伯特弹道重构与终端双脉冲机动，实现确定性的多脉冲行星际转移交会设计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Reachability Analysis-Informed Reinforcement Learning (RARL), which uses local first-order reachability ellipsoids to constrain intermediate waypoint selection and couples Lambert reconstruction with a terminal two-impulse maneuver for deterministic multi-impulse interplanetary transfer design.
